name: Zoho Desk
description: Zoho Desk is a customer-support platform for ticket handling, self-service, and automation. Channels, agent roles, department limits, and AI options vary by edition.
best_for: Support teams that want to choose a help-desk edition around who replies to customers, required departments, and channel workflows instead of the lowest advertised seat price.
features: Self-service knowledge base and messaging on applicable editions
Ticket assignment, workflows, and SLA rules
Multi-department support on Professional and Enterprise
Restricted internal collaboration through light-agent licenses
AI assistance with edition, provider, and region-dependent availability

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 3 agents; free forever. Email ticketing out of the box.

tiers.name: Express
tiers.notes: Up to 5 users. $7/agent/month billed annually or $9 billed monthly. Email, social channels, web forms and basic workflows; AI provider and edition requirements must be checked separately.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: No listed user-count cap; each full agent still requires a paid license. $14/agent/month billed annually or $20 billed monthly. Adds public knowledge base and messaging. Not the multi-department tier.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Up to 10 departments. $23/agent/month billed annually or $35 billed monthly. Adds telephony integration, Blueprints and round-robin assignment. Light-agent add-ons are separate from full-agent seats.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Up to 50 departments and 50 included light-agent licenses. $40/agent/month billed annually or $50 billed monthly. Adds skill-based routing, multi-brand help center and sandbox. Light agents cannot replace customer-facing agents.

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: A customer service platform with ticketing, live chat, and AI-powered automation.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams of all sizes needing an established, feature-rich helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Freshdesk
alternatives.description: A cloud-based help desk with ticketing, automation, and omnichannel support.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams wanting an affordable, easy-to-deploy helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A shared inbox and help desk platform built for personalized, human-feeling support.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized support teams wanting simple, email-centric ticketing.

pros: The Free edition supports an initial team of up to three agents.
The edition matrix makes user and department limits explicit.
Light-agent roles let internal specialists contribute private notes without giving them full ticket-handling responsibilities.
cons: Express is capped at five users; it is not a low-price plan for an unlimited support team.
Multi-department support requires Professional or Enterprise.
Light agents cannot reply to customers or own tickets. Verify add-on eligibility and pricing in the quote because the vendor help article and edition matrix differ on lower-plan availability.
